checks.name: g6-provider-live-claude-freshness
checks.summary: The M3live ground component provider-live-claude is a synthetic component absent from the evidence-keys output, so G6's declared-derivation rule governs it. ev-v2-063-provider-live-claude-refresh declares its derivation as the runner component's key and carries the value 1df4ccb0df3b3a7925b8c3cc2a83111e83c303b6f9bb0a05b457bf22f956c4c8. Recomputing that derivation at the judgment commit gives the runner key e52ef032cd4a7722ff2bd52649051cbc0d9bd9eb00d1ac1660a7495c24b88057. They do not match, and no other passed provider-live-claude entry exists. The mismatch was created by the V2-063 landing itself: after the live run and the record's final key measurement, the landed tree edited the doc comments of internal/runner/provider_live_test.go, a file inside the runner component's roots, so the key the record declares corresponds to no commit on the judged branch's history. The delta is comment-only and behaviour-preserving, but accepting the record on that argument would substitute reasoning for the measurement G6 exists to demand, the very substitution ev-v2-063 itself refused when it re-observed rather than argued; and a truthful re-issue must execute the live suite at the judgment commit, which this gate is barred from doing because a gate judgment starts no real Provider CLI. G6 is unsatisfied for the M3live ground component, and the gate fails on this rule.

checks.name: m3-completion-condition-mapping
checks.summary: All four roadmap M3 completion conditions map to passed checks in passed records. Condition 1, intake to Increment Artifact: ev-v2-016-runner end to end on the local closure and ev-v2-063 i1-happy-journey against the real CLI ending in a terminal success with a non-empty artifact digest. Condition 2, resume on a different Execution after a Runner crash: ev-v2-063 i5-i6 (real SIGKILL of the child process group, fresh Claim under a strictly greater fencing token, exactly one re-run to terminal success, then both late-accept rejections executed for real) plus caseb (crash after journaling re-adopts the journaled result with zero further invocations); V2-058's revision of the pinned rejection does not weaken this condition, because the set of accepted late submissions is empty before and after the change, the revision pins two independent rejections (domain.ErrStaleVersion for the crashed attempt's own replay, then domain.ErrLeaseExpired for the second probe at the superseded Execution's current version) where one was pinned before, and both executed for real in the refresh. Condition 3, the representative Provider's real Preview capability: ev-v2-063 i1 and i2 with ev-v2-047 declaring claude the representative Provider in the versioned capability declaration set. Condition 4, no credential in Control Plane, Work Packet or logs: ev-v2-063 i3 with its six sub-proofs plus the always-on credential-path AST scan and the secrets scan. The gate's failure is not a missing or failed verification of any milestone condition; it is the freshness binding of the record carrying the live half of conditions 2 through 4.

checks.name: gate-verdict
checks.summary: Verdict: the M3 gate does not pass at judgment commit ff605333c76dd1e252350dbc628301915d7637eb. Sole failing rule: G6 freshness of the M3live ground component provider-live-claude. Every other rule (G1, G2, G3, G4, G5, G7, and G6 for all 23 evidence-keys components after this gate's re-issue) is satisfied, and all four roadmap M3 completion conditions are substantively verified by passed records. Remediation proposal for the coordinator: a new live re-observation task that re-runs TestProviderLiveVerticalSlice's nine subtests against the real claude CLI at a commit whose runner key equals the then-current judgment key, issues a passed provider-live-claude record declaring that key, and whose completion commit adds only files outside the runner key closure (ledger records under .agents and operational docs), so the record cannot invalidate itself the way the V2-063 landing did; plus a standing rule for live tasks that the completion commit must not touch any file inside the exercised component's key closure after the final key measurement. This gate did not start any Provider CLI and made zero live invocations.
